tool_input.command:
hops fg derive tmp_derive_probe --base labels \
  --join "transactions:1 LEFT account_id" \
  --join "profiles:1 LEFT account_id" \
  --join "activity:1 LEFT account_id" \
  --join "account_health:1 LEFT account_id" \
  --primary-key account_id --event-time label_time \
  --description "probe" 2>&1 | grep -vE 'Reading|Finished|INFO|Closing|Connection|Waiting|UserWarning|proxy|compatibility|FutureWarning|VersionWarning' | tail -15
hops fg features tmp_derive_probe --version 1 2>/dev/null

hops fg delete tmp_derive_probe --version 1 2>&1 | grep -ivE 'Reading|Finished|INFO|Closing|Connection|Waiting|UserWarning|proxy|compatibility|Future|Version|Logged|absl|STDERR' | tail -3
mkdir -p .tmp
hops td read churn_fv 1 --td-version 1 --output .tmp/td_probe.csv 2>&1 | grep -iE 'wrote|saved|rows|error|✓' | tail -3
echo "--- file line count ---"; wc -l .tmp/td_probe.csv 2>/dev/null
echo "--- header ---"; head -1 .tmp/td_probe.csv 2>/dev/null
echo "--- unique account_id count ---"; tail -n +2 .tmp/td_probe.csv 2>/dev/null | cut -d, -f1 | sort -u | wc -l
tool_input.description: Delete probe FG, read full td to file, count rows and uniqueness

tool_input.command:
echo "=== duplicated account_ids ==="; tail -n +2 .tmp/td_probe.csv | cut -d, -f1 | sort | uniq -d

echo "=== rows for first dup id ==="; dup=$(tail -n +2 .tmp/td_probe.csv | cut -d, -f1 | sort | uniq -d | head -1); echo "id=$dup"; grep "^$dup," .tmp/td_probe.csv
